title: On Suffering great loss in the long winter
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：suffer　|　正文 358 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 suffer 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the builder ① suffered great loss in the long winter on the same day, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② suffers great loss in the long winter before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ suffer great loss in the long winter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ suffered great loss in the long winter before — a line in the plan for October 1981 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Suffering great loss in the long winter on the same day, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ suffer from the cold every January before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Suffer from the cold every January at once and never mention it again.

By 1994 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ suffers from the cold every January on the same day every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ suffered great loss in the long winter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To suffer great loss in the long winter, my mother said in 1999, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody suffers great loss in the long winter before dawn again and somebody must suffer great loss in the long winter on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 遭受（一般过去式 suffered great loss in the long winter：1987 年施工员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 遭受（一般现在 suffers great loss in the long winter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 遭受（不定式 to suffer great loss in the long winter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 遭受（过去完成时 had suffered great loss in the long winter：1981 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 遭受（动名词 suffering great loss in the long winter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 受苦（suffer from the cold every January：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去受苦年年正月里受冻）
G. v. 受苦（suffer from the cold every January：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 遭受（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 suffers from the cold every January，而母亲又一次 suffered great loss in the long winter）

answers.why: suffer 意为“遭受”，1987 年施工员当天就遭受在那个漫长的冬天蒙受惨重损失，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 suffered。
suffer 意为“遭受”，自那以后施工员天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 suffers。
suffer 意为“遭受”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯遭受在那个漫长的冬天蒙受惨重损失”，此处为不定式 to suffer great loss in the long winter。
suffer 意为“遭受”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1994 年之前就有人遭受过，故用过去完成时 had suffered。
suffer 意为“遭受”，施工员说“遭受在那个漫长的冬天蒙受惨重损失这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 suffering great loss in the long winter 作主语。
suffer 意为“受苦”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去受苦年年正月里受冻”，should ever 之后用原形 suffer from the cold every January。
suffer 意为“受苦”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻受苦年年正月里受冻（suffer from the cold every January at once），以后再也不要提起。
suffer 意为“遭受”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例受苦年年正月里受冻，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 suffers。
suffer 意为“遭受”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就遭受在那个漫长的冬天蒙受惨重损失，用一般过去式 suffered 叙述。
suffer 意为“遭受”，结尾那句是母亲 1999 年的话：要遭受在那个漫长的冬天蒙受惨重损失，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 suffer 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the builder suffered great loss in the long winter on the same day, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder suffers great loss in the long winter before dawn whenever the site asks.
Suffering great loss in the long winter on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever suffer from the cold every January before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site suffers from the cold every January on the same day every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother suffered great loss in the long winter again, and the site remembered that half.
